data.displayName: Origin Aff Var ePlus Ongoing -OBS- New & Move Cust Only

fees.description: A $70.47 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is reconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A $70.47 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is disconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A fee of $15.00 (GST exempt) may apply if your bill is not paid by the due date.
If you pay at an Australia Post outlet, a payment processing fee of the higher of $2.70 or 0.49% (incl GST) may apply.

gasContract.terms: Offer not available in all areas or properties connecting for first time. Residential customers only. Visit originenergy.com.au/2889/Terms-and-conditions for more.
gasContract.variation: We may vary the Charges (including their amount, nature and structure) by notice to you at any time. The notice will be at least 5 business days prior to the effective date of the variation.

incentives.description: One credit per gas account. If this Origin Affinity Variable ePlus Ongoing gas plan is still active with the customer on 31st December 2026, $160 (Incl. GST) credit will be applied to the customer's gas account after that date. If the customer ends this Origin Affinity Variable ePlus Ongoing gas plan before that date, the customer will not receive any credit. Credit is not redeemable for cash.

eligibility.description: You setup bills and letters by email. You can change at any time.
Offer only available to new residential electricity customers, and existing customers moving to a new property
Credit will only be applied if you haven't received a credit in the previous 12 months

gasContract.additionalFeeInformation: You may be required to pay any amounts that a Distributor or Meter Service Provider charges us for services provided at your Supply Address, including any metering-related goods or services, and which are not already incorporated into the Supply Charges or Energy Usage Charges. You can find out more at www.originenergy.com.au/2402/Additional-charges
